name: trackbuddy-parcel-tracker
description: Track packages from your AI agent: DHL, FedEx, UPS, Amazon Shipping, GOFO, SPX and 1,000+ carriers via 17TRACK (USPS, China Post, YunExpress, Cainiao, Royal Mail), plus Maersk containers. Paste tracking numbers, get status, ETA and scan history. Pay per record on your Apify account, no carrier API keys.

interface.longDescription: Track packages from your AI agent: DHL, FedEx, UPS, Amazon Shipping, GOFO, SPX and 1,000+ carriers via 17TRACK (USPS, China Post, YunExpress, Cainiao, Royal Mail), plus Maersk containers. Paste tracking numbers, get status, ETA and scan history. Pay per record on your Apify account, no carrier API keys. Includes 5 skills (bulk-tracking-report, delivery-exceptions, track-container, track-package, tracking-cost-estimate) and Apify's hosted MCP server limited to Imzlab's Actors. After installing, run `codex mcp login package-tracking` to sign in to Apify in the browser.
defaultPrompt: Where is container MSKU0078257 and when does it arrive?
Which tracking numbers in orders.csv are late? List the exceptions first.
